results.details: a GA RC cannot be cut from the current dirty worktree
GA requires a real active rights holder, governing law and CLA submission authority, plus source-shipped contribution, trademark, security, licence and in-product legal notices
one commit-bound RC must include every signed image digest, SBOM/provenance assertion, behavior manifest, source artifact and a cryptographically verified Sigstore bundle
Stage 1 final gate must be passed, source-bound and signed by an authorized automation identity on the RC (approved pilot evidence may use the behavior-equivalence rule)
Stage 2 final gate must be passed, source-bound and signed by an authorized automation identity on the RC (approved pilot evidence may use the behavior-equivalence rule)
Stage 3 final gate must be passed, source-bound and signed by an authorized automation identity on the RC (approved pilot evidence may use the behavior-equivalence rule)
Stage 4 final gate must be passed, source-bound and signed by an authorized automation identity on the RC (approved pilot evidence may use the behavior-equivalence rule)
Stage 5 final gate must be passed, source-bound and signed by an authorized automation identity on the RC (approved pilot evidence may use the behavior-equivalence rule)

independent penetration testing must be self-hashed, RC-bound and signed by a source-approved external authority, with zero unresolved Critical/High findings and no accepted cross-tenant, secret, side-effect, corruption, or approval-bypass risk
route_planner needs signed bilingual specialist and shared eval evidence with <=2pp regression and zero safety redlines
daily_planner needs signed bilingual specialist and shared eval evidence with <=2pp regression and zero safety redlines
coach needs signed bilingual specialist and shared eval evidence with <=2pp regression and zero safety redlines
evaluator needs signed bilingual specialist and shared eval evidence with <=2pp regression and zero safety redlines
artifact_builder needs signed bilingual specialist and shared eval evidence with <=2pp regression and zero safety redlines
official cloud must provide signed RC-bound evidence for 30 steady minutes plus a 2x five-minute burst, every SLO, and backlog recovery within 15 minutes
instance/AZ, region, and queue-loss recovery must provide signed RC-bound evidence meeting fixed RPO/RTO thresholds
100 randomly selected accounts need signed, RC-bound cross-surface deletion and restore-time re-deletion evidence
compose needs signed RC-bound evidence for three consecutive fresh-install, upgrade, backup, restore, and rollback passes
helm-tofu needs signed RC-bound evidence for three consecutive fresh-install, upgrade, backup, restore, and rollback passes
official-cloud needs signed RC-bound evidence for three consecutive fresh-install, upgrade, backup, restore, and rollback passes
a source-authorized, five-party pilot report and signed exact pilot-to-RC behavior comparison are required; any affected behavior change requires a new frozen cohort
the signed RC issue inventory must contain zero open P0/P1 issues
final approval must be signed by a source-authorized release authority and bind at least five accountable signatures to the exact RC and all evidence hashes
